entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your timing and fierceness take the enemy by surprise.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): When an ally with this feat hits with an attack of opportunity against an enemy both you and that ally are threatening, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your melee attack rolls against that enemy for 1 round.
